goal: Resolve nominated evidence and registered parents without replaying unrelated history, while preserving current scoped source-use authority.
procedure: Read the selected successor plan and the current amplification path before coding. Expose the source digest, stream position and commit time already persisted by trusted registration; do not invent a new authority row or generation. Add a fresh one-record Kurrent target proof with strict SDK records and current receiver/owner checks. Build an explicitly named selected-source-closure-v1 resolver that discovers nominated originals and registered parents within a cap, validates physical lineage, runs actual source-purpose callbacks, independently rereads selected commitments, and finishes with a finite source/raw/action/head XTDB statement. Detach returned metadata from callback inputs. Keep default consumers and whole-history integrity checks unchanged. Add controlled failure/race tests and actual-engine integration cases, then publish for the original CI gate.
authority: Registration is a locator, not physical presence or permission. Target proofs cover nominated events only. Terminal row observations certify the selected scoped metadata basis; no later read lease, whole-stream certificate, learned judgment or cross-engine transaction is created.
validation: The selected SDK 1.3.3 bounded get_stream contract and physical record fields were inspected. All 95 restored dependency blobs match Alice pin 4f287a488bc908bd04f99255ee01b794bacba50b. Focused exact lookup, registry, closure, old phase, context and lineage tests are recorded in the verification checkpoint. Integration discovery includes all 49 actual-engine cases exactly once across the original 12 shards, with 34 in core and six new target/closure cases. Physical execution awaits CI; local Docker is unavailable. Prior 90 procedure traces passed the Python shape validator.
failure_or_lesson: Exact target lookup does not detect unrelated corruption or duplicates and cannot silently replace whole-stream integrity. Frozen dataclasses still expose mutable nested aliases; detach observations and guard primitive comparisons after the terminal query. Bound native methods must belong to the captured owner. Kurrent append returns a global commit position, so obtain actual per-stream revision for reappend fault tests. Registration source-item references must bind original provenance or the raw object ID. This implementation is a selective infrastructure route; consumer adoption and ordinary latency qualification remain open.
